architecture_reference.notes: The FastConformer graph, TDT joint network, anti-diagonal loss, greedy duration decoder, feature extractor, tokenizer contract, and timestamp semantics were audited at this exact revision. VoiceHub imports none of Transformers at runtime.

semantic_reference.notes: TDT loss and decoding semantics were compared with NVIDIA NeMo v2.4.0. The active checkpoint namespace follows the official Safetensors conversion.

tokenizer_references.notes: BPE, byte fallback, Metaspace, added-token, and decoder behavior.
SentencePiece precompiled normalization character-map format and Darts-trie traversal.

inference: LSTM prediction network and token-duration joint head
greedy duration-aware decoding with blank cache reuse and safety bound
word timestamps derived from TDT durations
strict Safetensors inventory verification and portable reload
limitations: Only TDT checkpoints are accepted; Parakeet CTC and RNNT require separate native architectures.
Only greedy decoding is implemented. Beam search, hotwords, streaming state, translation, and language forcing fail closed.
The multilingual checkpoint auto-detects language but does not expose a separately verified language classifier.
No corpus-level WER benchmark was run, so no accuracy improvement over NVIDIA's published checkpoint is claimed.
